Sandbox_HaloDrop_PlaneSpeed_tooltip: Virtual flight speed. While aboard the character does not actually move (sky view), only the map scrolls, so any value works. The horizontal speed inherited on jumping has its own cap (JUMP_PLANE_SPEED 12). In the default area (about 20000x16000) 200 means a 1-2 minute crossing.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_WorldX1_tooltip: West edge of the rectangle the plane crosses (world tile coordinates). Each round picks a random straight line through this rectangle; its two ends are the start A and the end B. Default 0,0 - 19968,16128 = B42 vanilla map cells (0,0)-(77,62) (256 tiles per cell).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_WorldY1_tooltip: North edge of the flight area (world tile coordinates).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_WorldX2_tooltip: East edge of the flight area (world tile coordinates).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_WorldY2_tooltip: South edge of the flight area (world tile coordinates). Ignored if the area is smaller than 300x300.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_AvoidEmptyNW_tooltip: When on, routes are re-rolled so they do not cross the empty north-west of the vanilla map (cells x<45 and y<18, plus the triangle above the (45,3)-(58,0) line). Turn off for other maps.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_PlaneZ_tooltip: The real floor the jump plane vehicle flies at (max 31, the engine floor limit). With CarryZ 31 it flies at the same floor as the jumper.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CarryZ_tooltip: The real floor the character is on when jumping (3-31, 31 is the engine limit). During the fall it descends from this floor to floor 3 in proportion to the virtual altitude, so free fall looks faster than the canopy; below floor 3 the engine fall takes over. Above 12 requires Viewpoint 1st/3rd person: in isometric view the camera shifts 3 tiles per floor out of the loaded area (black screen, frame stalls, run 7).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_JumpAltitude_tooltip: Virtual altitude at the jump. Sets how long the free fall lasts.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallSpeed_tooltip: Vertical speed while diving with W + run key (PUBG 234 km/h). No input is 77% of this, glide (W) and brake (S) are 54%. Hitting the ground at this speed causes heavy injury.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopySpeed_tooltip: Descent speed under the parachute with no input. W is 119%, W + run key 150%, S 85%. Slows down automatically just before landing.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallSteer_tooltip: Top speed in the facing direction (turn with A/D) while gliding with W. Right after the jump you keep the plane's speed, which decays to this value.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopySteer_tooltip: Top forward speed with W under the parachute.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallTurnRate_toolti: How fast the body turns while A/D is held. Turning is never instant.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopyTurnRate_tooltip: A/D turn rate under the parachute.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_PitchRate_tooltip: How fast the posture leans fully when W/S is held. 2.0 means half a second. Releasing returns at the same rate.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallAccel_tooltip: How quickly the current speed converges on the target speed. Higher is snappier, lower is more inertia.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopyAccel_tooltip: How quickly speed converges on the canopy targets after the chute opens. Lower keeps the free fall speed longer (PUBG slingshot).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_AutoOpenAltitude_toolti: The parachute opens by itself at this altitude during free fall. 0 disables it.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_HideCarried_tooltip: Hides players (including yourself) while they are inside the plane.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneX1_tooltip: West edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive). Only players inside this zone when the round starts board the plane. Used only when X2 > X1 and Y2 > Y1; leave all four at 0 to board every player. Defaults to the oil rig.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneY1_tooltip: North edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneX2_tooltip: East edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneY2_tooltip: South edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive). Floor (height) is not checked.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_SkyView_tooltip: While aboard the plane the world is not drawn; the map with the plane is shown instead (the client cannot stream land fast enough at flight speed).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_SkyZoom_tooltip: World map zoom level used by the sky view (higher = closer).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_JumpWaitMax_tooltip: After pressing jump, how long to wait (under the clouds) for the land below and the plane to load before falling anyway.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_SkyScale: Sky view tile scale (px per square)
Sandbox_HaloDrop_SkyScale_tooltip: Screen pixels per world square when the sky view draws photo tiles. Lower = higher and farther.
